name: Betcity
note: Front, back and shorts sponsor on Dynamo Makhachkala's 2026-27 home kit (club kit launch, 2026-07-25; kit designer case, 2026-08-13). Left unrated: the holding ООО «Бетсити» that controls operator LLC Fortuna is now owned through personal funds (60% «Мак», ex-founder Sergey Samsonenko) whose beneficiaries are undisclosed (Gorod N, 2025-02-08), so the ultimate owner could not be named. No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
